# clio ops reindex

Rebuild derived indexes (live run requires --confirm); `--dry-run` is report-only and applies nothing, so a report-only run is not reported as ok. A lexical rebuild replaces legacy plaintext index rows with keyed term digests. Ops exit codes: 0 healthy or completed, 1 domain/runtime failure or findings, 2 usage or repair refusal, 3 reindex failed or ran report-only

## Usage

```
clio ops reindex [--db PATH] [--backend sqlite|postgres] [--bank BANK] [--target dense|lexical|all] [--dry-run] [--confirm]
```

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--target dense\|lexical\|all` | enum: dense, lexical, all |  | Index legs `ops_cli`'s reindex rebuilds. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Report-only: applies nothing and is not reported as ok (`--confirm` is the live switch). |
| `--confirm` |  |  | Signals the live path: `ops repair` applies only with it, and `ops reindex` is report-only without it. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Rebuild the lexical index.
```
clio ops reindex --target lexical --confirm
```

Report the cost of rebuilding both legs; applies nothing.
```
clio ops reindex --target all
```

Rebuild one store's lexical index.
```
clio ops reindex --target lexical --confirm --db ./memory.db
```
